name: Aizawa Minori
source:
A distinguished lady born to a high-class family. Everybody sees her as an excellent wife with a gentle and calm personality, but behind her demeanor is a high need for social approval.

Because she was strictly disciplined when it comes to virtue, she feels a strong recoil from the sense of immorality, which then turns into sexual pleasure. 

Although she loves her husband, they're not sexually compatible, so she is frustrated.

In the past, to satisfy her need for social approval, she used to do cosplay and live streaming. Around that time she met Yuujirou​, who she dated for a while. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.hendingerg.com/products/kasen/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
